notes.title: Tokyo Game Show Sales and Announcements!
notes.content:
Tokyo Game Show has started! 
Playism is not only exhibiting some awesome games, but we are also joining up with Steam to hold some Tokyo Game Show Sales for everyone worldwide to join in! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Playism/list/36822][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/3eee776fe0e4ee8c08c44802f9b3fe3a10f3eb48.jpg[/img]

Find the full list of Playism titles on Sale here![/url]

As well as a huge selection of games on Sale, Playism is also proud to present our upcoming games and projects! 

[h1]CINERIS SOMNIA[/h1]
CINERIS SOMNIA is a 3D adventure through a beautifully strange and mesmerizing world.
Coming Soon to Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/752470/CINERIS_SOMNIA/

[h1]Star Sky 3[/h1]
In the starry light of the sky above, a story is waiting to unfold.
Explore the final chapter of the Blue Moon saga, coming soon to Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/933770/Star_Sky_3___3/

[h1]N1RV Ann-A[/h1]
(Japanese Only)
Cyberpunk Bartender Action N1RV Ann-A (pronounced simply as Nirvana) is a booze em' up about waifus, technology, and life in the dystopian economic bubble.
Coming soon to PC, Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP)
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 9 Indie Game Corner 9-B60[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/914210/N1RV_AnnA_Cyberpunk_Bartender_Action/


[h1]VA-11 Hall-A[/h1]
(Japanese Only)
You are a bartender at VA-11 HALL-A, affectionately nicknamed "Valhalla." Although it is just a small bar downtown, it attracts the most fascinating people this side of dystopia. Keep your clients lubricated and you will be made privy to the most interesting stories.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/447530/VA11_HallA_Cyberpunk_Bartender_Action/


[h1]Night in the Woods[/h1]
(Japanese Only)
College dropout Mae Borowski returns home to the crumbling former mining town of Possum Springs seeking to resume her aimless former life and reconnect with the friends she left behind. But things aren't the same. Home seems different now and her friends have grown and changed. Leaves are falling and the wind is growing colder. Strange things are happening as the light fades.
Coming soon to PC (JP), Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP), Xbox One (JP)
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 9 Indie Game Corner 9-B43[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/481510/Night_in_the_Woods/


[h1]Astebreed[/h1]
Climb into the cockpit of an otherworldly war machine and fly into battle against a horrifying alien race bent on eradicating humanity to preserve their own civilization.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch. 


[h1]Croixleur Sigma[/h1]
Wielding magic blades, four girls fight back successive waves of monsters in this exhilarating hack-and-slash action game!
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch. 


[h1]Will -A Wonderful World-[/h1]
(Japanese Only)
A young girl wakes up, groggy in an unknown room. A talking dog appears before her and she becomes startled by the revelation he tells her: They are gods and it is their duty to change the fate of any humans that ask for their help. Letters appear in the mail and with pen in hand she begins her job.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch (JP) and PlayStation 4 (JP)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/588040/WILL_A_Wonderful_World__WILL/


[h1]La-Mulana 2 OST[/h1]
The Original Soundtrack for La-Mulana 2 has now been released! Relive the ruins with 59 tracks! 
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 5, Konami Booth[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/916280/LAMULANA_2_Original_Sound_Track/

notes.title: Today, "White Out" and "Yami" have been added to The Silver Case
notes.content:
Everyone who has been enjoying The Silver Case HD Remaster PC version. 
We are really excited to announce that today, we have added "White Out" and "Yami" to the game. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/15e5863617d908a1f84875e2da9bdaccc48e4c3f.jpg[/img]

"White Out" has been added as a new chapter to "Transmitter" within the game, whereas "Yami" has been added to "Placebo". 

In addition to this, some adjustments to the game regarding some movies/images and additional achievements have also been included. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/eaeb9849b4d61abafe9bedd6ba6d3c4a2ec17eab.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional Contents[/h1]
① Transmitter: Added the scenario "White Out"
[list][*]Scenario written by Goichi Suda
[*]Illustrations by Takashi Miyamoto[/list]

Placebo: Added the scenario "Yami" 
[list][*]Scenario written by Masahi Ooka
[*]Illustrations by Masaki Ikeda[/list]

② New Song Remix
[list][*]Menu Selection Screen Music Remix: Akira Yamaoka & Erika Ito
[*]New tracks made for the new scenarios[/list]

③ Transmitter: Sayaka Baian's New Design
[list][*]Fully remade movies. Cast: Arisa Matsunaga 
* It is possible to switch between the original version and the remastered version in the graphic settings.
[*]Comic Beam Cover and inside illustration has been refreshed[/list]

④ Addition of new achievements
[list][*]Added 8 new achievements[/list]

We will update all the platforms (Steam / PLAYISM / GOG / Humble Store) sequentially from May 30th Japan Time. 

* Please note: The added scenarios are the as the additional scenarios which were released on PS4 in North America / Europe.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/476650/The_Silver_Case/

notes.title: Two New Chapters Coming to The Silver Case
notes.content:
Hi All

We are happy to announce two new scenarios will be added to “The Silver Case” HD remaster PC Version which tie the main story and its upcoming sequel together.

“White Out” will be a new chapter added to “Transmitter” within the game, whereas “Yami” will be added to “Placebo”. This new content will be added in a free update. 

In addition to this, some adjustments to the game regarding some movies/images and additional achievements will also be included in the update.  

[h1]The update is scheduled for May 30th, 2017 Japan Standard Time. [/h1]

We hope you look forward to it. 

* Please note: The added scenarios are the as the additional scenarios which were released on PS4 in North America / Europe.

notes.title: The Silver Case has been Released
notes.content:
On October 7th 1999, “The Silver Case” original game was released. Exactly 17 years later, we are proud to present “The Silver Case” Remastered for PC on October 7th, 2016. The set price of the game is $19.99 (including tax), with a 10% discount during launch week. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/476650

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/6f5a54ed3a9d3fd7f0f9ab8ae60fb772a9277ef1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Features of “The Silver Case” Deluxe version[/h1]
In addition to the standard version, we have also prepared a Deluxe version including a glamorous range of extra content.
 
■The Art Book
A collection of artwork made during development, all in 40p full color PDF format. The setincludes new artmade for the HD Remastered game for PC by Takashi Miyamoto.
 
■The Digital Comic
A 22 page digital comic following the story leading up tothe game’s opening“#0 Lunatics”.Concept by SUDA51, manga by Syuji Takeya.

■ Original Soundtrack
Of course, the extra content includes Akira Yamaoka’s remixed soundtrack created for the Remastered game, comprised of 34 tracks in wav and mp3 format.

[h1]Features of “The Silver Case” Physical version[/h1]

[img=https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0912/7444/products/SilverCase-PC-2_833b989a-b394-4f80-af08-7fcea0e86b24_grande.png?v=1475601293]

The Silver Case and Limited Run Games have partnered up to bring The Silver Case Physical version.
 
The Physical Version of The Silver Case contains: 
[list][*]DRM-free game disc with installer
[*]Soundtrack on CD
[*]Art book
[*]22-page manga
[*]Two-piece manual set
[*]Individually numbered box - numbers will be issued by order of purchase. The box is 7.75" x 9.5" x 1.75" - the same box dimensions as many classic [*]PC games from the 80s and 90s.
[*]Game download on Steam[/list]

Orders for this item will be open until midnight on October 20th.

Price: $ 49.99
Website: https://limitedrungames.com/products/the-silver-case-pc


We hope you enjoy The Silver Case!

notes.title: New Trailer and New Demo!
notes.content:
Hi guys

As we are getting closer to the release of The Silver Case, we are super excited to bring you some new updates! 


[h1]New Trailer[/h1]
Firstly, we want to present the new trailer for the release of The Silver Case

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=20YJxIQO1Qg
The new trailer includes a new opening movie created for the HD Remaster version. It also includes the remixed opening track that Akira Yamaoka created for the game.


[h1]Updated Demo[/h1]
We have updated the demo build today to include the prologue scenario "#0 Lunatics" which was shown at Tokyo Game Show 2016.

Players who created save data in the demo version will be able to continue using their saved data with the full game from October 7th. 
[i]* Please note that the demo version represents a work in development and there may be differences with the product version.[/i]


[b]■ New System Features[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/c78bb10db465f3e01c374b51ddf8eb94e0f77bd9.jpg[/img]

[list][*]Language selection
[*]Full screen/window mode switching
[*]Changes to the resolution
[*]Changes to the 3D quality 
[*]Improved sound and music[/list]

 
[b]■ Choose between settings for the original version and the HD Remaster version[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/183f8d6a889644c94c94679a94bf7637fddbf1d9.jpg[/img]

It is also possible to toggle a number of elements between the format of the original game and the new HD Remaster version.
[list][*]Movement speed
[*]Text speed
[*]Music
[*]CG movies
[*]Opening movie
[*]UI[/list]

[h1]Its nearly time for Kamui to awaken[/h1]

tags.feature: The new trailer includes a new opening movie created for the HD Remaster version.

We have updated the demo build today to include the prologue scenario "#0 Lunatics" which was shown at Tokyo Game Show 2016.

Players who created save data in the demo version will be able to continue using their saved data with the full game from October 7th. 
[i]* Please note that the demo version represents a work in development and there may be differences with the product version.[/i]


[b]■ New System Features[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/c78bb10db465f3e01c374b51ddf8eb94e0f77bd9.jpg[/img]

[list][*]Language selection
[*]Full screen/window mode switching
[*]Changes to the resolution
[*]Changes to the 3D quality 
[*]Improved sound and music[/list]

 
[b]■ Choose between settings for the original version and the HD Remaster version[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717321/183f8d6a889644c94c94679a94bf7637fddbf1d9.jpg[/img]

It is also possible to toggle a number of elements between the format of the original game and the new HD Remaster version.
[list][*]Movement speed
[*]Text speed
[*]Music
[*]CG movies
[*]Opening movie
[*]UI[/list]

[h1]Its nearly time for Kamui to awaken[/h1]

notes.title: The Silver Case Demo
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! 

We are super excited to announce that we are sharing the demo of The Silver Case that we showed at BitSummit in July! 

The demo version allows you to play the start of the chapter Decoyman. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/493860

The controls are as follows: 

[h1][Mouse][/h1]
Confirm …Left click
Cancel …Right click
Move …Click directional buttons in the movement menu
Look up ...Scroll the mouse wheel up while the movement menu is displayed
Look down ...Scroll the mouse wheel down while the movement menu is displayed
Move (dash) …Hold down the left mouse button while moving
Examine …Select C (Contact) from the control menu 


[h1][Keyboard][/h1]
Confirm … Enter or Space
Cancel … ESC
Move …Arrow keys while the movement menu is displayed
Look up ...PageUp
Look down ...PageDown
Move (dash) …Hold down Enter or Space while moving
Examine …C key


[h1][Controller][/h1]
Confirm … B button
Cancel …A button
Move …D-pad or left stick
Look up ...LB or LT while the movement menu is displayed
Look down ...RB or RT  while the movement menu is displayed
Move (dash) …Press down on the B button while moving
Examine …Y button

We hope you enjoy it!!
